test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Amit, Binod, Chandu and Dixit are sitting on four consecutive seats in a theatre. But Chandu and Dixit are not sitting together and Binod is not sitting in the third place. If Amit and Binod are sitting together, then which of the following must be necessarily true?

options.text: Chandu is at the first place
Dixit is not at the first place
Amit is at the third place
Dixit is at the first place

solution:
1) Chandu and Dixit are not sitting together.

2) Binod is not sitting in third place.

3) Amit and Binod are sitting together, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0db46a8ecda9047a2e6247147fa9e4829050c5f0f3ea9cf8634e72f0575acc3a.png] 

The position of Chandu and Dixit cannot be determined.

So, only one statement is true i.e. Amit is at third place.

Hence, option (3) is the correct answer.
